build_pyrender_rasterizer: build a PyrenderRasterizer renderer using the build function with RendererType.PYRENDER_RASTERIZER
build_renderer_with_kwargs: build a renderer instance passing optional keyword arguments like asset_library to the build function
use_renderer_type_enum: use the RendererType enum to select PYRENDER_RASTERIZER as the renderer type for the build function
review_renderer_type_enum: review the RendererType enum which defines PYRENDER_RASTERIZER as the available renderer option
review_build_function: review the build function that constructs a renderer based on the provided RendererType enum value
